_note: A generic starting set so the pipeline runs out of the box. It is not the tuned set tos.watch uses; write your own questions for the changes you care about, and check them against changes you've labelled by hand before trusting the threshold. Put your set in pipeline/questions.json (gitignore it if it's yours).

data_use.instructions: Does this edit change what personal data the company collects, uses, or shares?

ai.instructions: Does this edit concern AI features or using people's data for AI?

noise.instructions: Is this edit only formatting, headings, dates, or navigation?
